searchText: I don't think it can be solved, but there are still two use cases for this channel: 1) reports from trusted users 2) reports against clear impersonators (made obvious by account name) discord recently added ability to disable DMs from non-friends on a server by server basis, maybe that can be recommended in reply to other cases A cursory look at this channel shows that most reports are from regular users, so a good rule of thumb would be to just ban reports from users you recognize. This at least would force spammers to be a little more interactive in looking for users that are online but do not post often

I don't think it can be solved, but there are still two use cases for this channel:

1) reports from trusted users
2) reports against clear impersonators (made obvious by account name)

discord recently added ability to disable DMs from non-friends on a server by server basis, maybe that can be recommended in reply to other cases
